The claim states that a view-dependent step computes a visibility-sorted index array referencing occupancy geometry in front-to-back order, which is required for correct rasterization. It further explains that this is necessary because 'the rasterization of ray segment lists below must be performed in visibility order with respect to the current view point.' The source also details the specific mechanics (traversing the tree, emitting indices for front/back faces) that constitute this 'view-dependent step,' fully aligning with the claim.
